source: OURS: a hand-made table, not extracted data. tools/data/class-skills.json keeps only the Damage rows of Skill.dat (tools/class_skills.py damage_rows); the heal, heal-over-time, stat and debuff rows of the same SkillEffect list were never exported, so every value here is our choice until they are.
regenerate: With the client: research/local/game-catalog-v2/entries.jsonl (kind 'skills') carries each skill's SkillEffect rows under relationships.effects[].rows (EffectType + EffectValueList), the rows tools/class_skills.py reads for Damage. Extending damage_rows to the heal/abnormal EffectTypes (and tools/box_data.py _abnormals to the class skills' Abnormal_True ids: SkillAbnormal table-000 / SkillAbnormalEffect table-001) would replace this table with extracted values; the server reads the same fields from here.
formula: heal = roll(flat) + power * roll(ratio) / 10000 + target HPMax * roll(hp_ratio) / 10000, power = the caster's weapon roll + FixingDamage (the attack of Combat.SkillHits). A dot tick is roll(flat) + power * roll(ratio) / 10000 against the NPC's defense like a hit.
targets: self: the caster. friendly: the selected player when on the map, alive, within heal_range and not an enemy (same race or same party), else the caster; a selected hostile NPC or enemy player refuses the cast. enemy: the selected hostile NPC. dead_friendly: a dead friendly player in range.
